notes: 4K and 16:10 panels draw the interface at the same size as a 1080p set: the app lays out on a 960-wide canvas and scales it to fill the screen, so cards, text and buttons are no longer tiny on sets that report a large dp size. Plus 5.1.0: the TV catches up with the site — AI in the side rail, a film page with its poster and genre chips, sources in plain words (the row saves, Stream beside it), a slimmer player with intro and credits marks, Continue Watching with the frame you stopped on, and the billboard turned by LEFT/RIGHT on its buttons (UP opens the rail).
